svg.title: JGDMS three-layer policy stack
svg.desc: Detailed diagram of the three-layer policy stack: SpiffePolicyFile, RemotePolicyProvider, DynamicPolicyProvider, with InMemoryPolicyService wire format and grant flow.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain DynamicPolicyProvider in detail including void grant eviction')
g.text: ProtectionDomainGrant / ClassLoaderGrant hold weak refs only
Lazy eviction: it.remove() on all four iterator sites
No clearCache() needed on void detection

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain RemotePolicyProvider in detail including GrantPermission validation')
sendPrompt('Explain SpiffePolicyFile and the bootstrap trust chain')
g.text: Source: HTTPS + SPIFFE SVID client cert + CA pinning
Fail-secure: node does not start if unreachable
Grants: SPIRE socket · reach InMemoryPolicyService · minimal

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain InMemoryPolicyService including the String[] wire format and replace() validation')
g.text: Validation after parse: caller holds GrantPermission for each perm
Lease management: LandlordLease · async dispatch: bounded queue

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the DirtyChai administrator push policy to InMemoryPolicyService?')
g.text: Sends String[] over JERI wire — no @AtomicSerial needed
